_readme: Every recorded line in Hollow Manor. Change or add a line here (and in VoiceLines.swift), then run tools/voices/generate.sh. Only changed lines are made again. 'speed' is optional (1.0 is normal).

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Come out, come out. I won't bite. Much.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: This house has a lot of rooms. I know every one of them.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: I can smell the rain on you.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: Hiding again? You can't hide forever.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Welcome to Hollow Manor, sweetheart. We've been expecting you.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Did you hear that, darling? I think our guest is downstairs.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Darling, go and look. Somebody is walking around down there.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Come out, sweetheart. Dinner's getting cold.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Your friend asked about you. Isn't that sweet?

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Oh, don't cry. You're part of the family now.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Leaving so soon? You'll be back. They always come back.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Hey. It's me. I know it's been a while. I'm at a big house called Hollow Manor, and I need you. Please come. Come alone.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: If you found this tape, don't trust the letter. They made me write it. The front door key is always hidden somewhere downstairs, in a drawer or a cupboard. Search quietly. He hears everything. And stay off the hallway floorboards if he's close.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: I can hear your heart beating.

lines.speaker: hunter
lines.text: So close now. I can smell you.
